recipe.visualDefinition: A four-panel grid composition featuring two sepia-toned portraits of men in western attire, a stylized steer skull on a blue field, and a waving American flag, all unified by a central typographic logo and a hand-drawn white border frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical quadrant division using thin white hand-drawn lines
Centralized typographic focal point overlapping all four quadrants
Color-coded quadrants representing red, white, and blue motifs
Contrast between high-detail portraiture and graphic iconography
coreInvariants: The steer skull icon as a recurring motif in both graphic and typographic forms
Distressed, weathered texture applied across all panels
Sepia-toned skin tones for human subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portraits occupy the top-right and bottom-left quadrants; graphic icons occupy the top-left and bottom-right. The logo is centered at the intersection.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white distressed typography and the steer skull icon integrated into the lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Clockwise from the top-left graphic to the top-right portrait, down to the flag, and finishing on the bottom-left portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with imagery and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sepia and warm browns in portraits and flag stripes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue in the top-left quadrant.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the hand-drawn borders and central typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between dark backgrounds and white graphic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Primary display text uses a heavy, distressed slab serif with woodblock-style imperfections
Secondary text uses a wide, modern sans-serif with high horizontal tracking
Integration of a steer skull icon into the horizontal bar of the primary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is smaller and tucked between the two main words
The 'O's in the primary text have a vertical, slightly condensed oval shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed decorative slab serif paired with a clean, wide-tracked modern sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the woodblock western aesthetic of the primary text.
Matches the wide, square proportions of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid. Top-left: A white steer skull graphic on a textured navy blue background. Top-right: A sepia-toned portrait of a bearded man looking down. Bottom-left: A sepia-toned portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat. Bottom-right: A close-up of a waving American flag in muted red and white tones. Apply a thin, hand-drawn white border around the entire frame and between quadrants.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, distressed white slab-serif text in the center, overlapping all four quadrants. Integrate a steer skull icon into the middle of the text. Below this, add a widely-spaced sans-serif subtitle flanked by small decorative flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the grid division visible but hand-drawn?
Does the central text have a weathered, woodcut texture?
Are the portraits sepia-toned to match the overall palette?
Is the steer skull icon present in both the top-left and the logo?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the men
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white borders look hand-sketched, not perfectly straight.
Verify the central logo is legible despite the distress texture.
Check that the flag stripes are muted and not overly vibrant.
Confirm the steer skull icon is stylized and not a realistic photo.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Western Iconography] + [Sepia Portraiture] in a [2x2 Grid] with [Distressed Slab-Serif Typography] and [Hand-Drawn Borders].
